name: Botlierskop Tented Lodge
address: Gonnakraal Road, Little Brak River, 6503, South Africa
description_short: Safari lodge dining with African-inspired cuisine amid the bushveld between Mossel Bay and George.
description_long:
Set within a private game reserve near Little Brak River, Botlierskop Tented Lodge offers a unique dining experience that combines safari adventure with refined African cuisine. The restaurant serves guests staying at the lodge as well as day visitors, with tables overlooking the reserve where you might spot wildlife while enjoying your meal.

The menu showcases local ingredients and traditional South African flavours, from hearty venison dishes to fresh coastal seafood, all prepared with a contemporary touch. Whether you're here for a bush breakfast before a game drive or a candlelit dinner under the stars, the setting is unforgettable. The lodge's elevated position provides sweeping views across the bushveld toward the Outeniqua Mountains.

Located just off the N2 between Mossel Bay and George, Botlierskop makes an excellent stop for travellers wanting to experience something beyond the typical Garden Route restaurant. The combination of game viewing, spa facilities, and quality dining creates a memorable escape into the African wilderness without straying far from the coastal route.
